fields.description:
Objective

Create an Operator record type on the Account object so books/brands are governed records. One Operator per brand.

Fields

  • Operator ID — Operator_ID__c — Auto Number, External ID, Unique

  • Operator Name — Name — Text(255), Required — duplicate prevention enforced

  • Supported Verticals — Supported_Verticals__c — Multi-Select Picklist — use WT_Vertical global value set

  • Default Market — Default_Market__c — Picklist — use WT_Market global value set (changed from design-doc lookup)

  • Default Currency — Default_Currency__c — Picklist — CAD; USD

  • Active Status — Active_Status__c — Picklist — Active; Paused; Inactive; Review Required

  • Operator Aliases — Operator_Aliases__c — Long Text Area — semicolon-separated raw source values that map to this Operator

  • Default CPA Value — Default_CPA_Value__c — Currency

  • Default Commission Rules — Default_Commission_Rules__c — Long Text Area

  • Default Redeposit Required — Default_Redeposit_Required__c — Checkbox

  • Default Redeposit Range Min — Default_Redeposit_Range_Min__c — Currency

  • Default Redeposit Range Max — Default_Redeposit_Range_Max__c — Currency

  • Default Target Average Redeposit Amount — Default_Target_Avg_Redeposit__c — Currency

  • Default Immediate Redeposit Timeframe — Default_Immediate_Redeposit_Timeframe__c — Text(255)

  • Default Immediate Redeposit Trigger Event — Default_Immediate_Redeposit_Trigger__c — Text(255)

  • Default Applicable Redeposit Types — Default_Applicable_Redeposit_Types__c — Text(255)

Implementation Requirements

  • Create the Operator record type on Account with its own page layout

  • Create all fields listed above with help text per the design doc field table (story B-01)

Acceptance Criteria

  • Operator is a distinct Account record type with its own layout

  • Suffix variants do not create new Operators; they resolve via the aliases field

Testing Notes

Create FanDuel, Fanatics, BetMGM, OLG from sample data.

Out of Scope

Duplicate prevention rules (BUILD-08). Alias-matching automation. Child alias object.

Open Questions

  • Are Default Commission Rules / Redeposit Timeframe / Trigger / Types values finite? If yes, convert those Text fields to picklists (client to confirm).

Additional Notes

  • If sprint time runs short, the Default Redeposit fields (last 7 in the list) can be added after the demo without impact — everything else is needed for the data load.

  • Field help text: copy from design doc story B-01.

Estimate: M · ~8h · Dependencies: POC-05 (Market global value set) · Ticket POC-03 (approved 2026-07-04)
